description: Header file defining a template class 'AtomicHook' for managing function hooks with thread-safe atomic operations, used for implementing Abseil customization hooks.

classes.name: AtomicHook<ReturnType (*)(Args...)>
classes.description: A thread-safe, atomic wrapper for function hooks, allowing registration and invocation of callback functions.

methods.name: AtomicHook()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the hook to a no-op.

methods.name: AtomicHook(FnPtr default_fn)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hook with a default function.

methods.name: void Store(FnPtr fn)
methods.description: Stores a function pointer as the hook, intended to be called once.

methods.name: template <typename... CallArgs> ReturnType operator()(CallArgs&&... args) const
methods.description: Invokes the registered hook with provided arguments.

methods.name: FnPtr Load() const
methods.description: Returns the currently registered hook or nullptr if none.
